55: A valley: in summer time  is a private domain in respect of the laws of Shabbat, but as a public domain in respect of those of uncleanness;  In the summer there are more people in the valley working the fields. Therefore, for matters of uncleanness it is considered a public domain. When it comes to Shabbat it is still a private domain, or, as we explained in yesterday's mishnah, at least not a public domain.

And in the rainy season it is regarded as a private domain in both respects.  In the rainy season people can't work the land in the valleys. Therefore, it is not considered a public domain for either purpose.
